$bookId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['title', 'author', 'genre', 'totalPages', 'pagesRead', 'status', 'rating', 'finishedAt']) && ((newData.child('status').val() === 'Terminado' && newData.child('pagesRead').val() === newData.child('totalPages').val() && newData.child('rating').val() >= 1 && newData.child('rating').val() <= 5 && newData.child('finishedAt').val() > 0) || (newData.child('status').val() !== 'Terminado' && newData.child('rating').val() === 0 && newData.child('finishedAt').val() === 0)) && (newData.child('status').val() !== 'Por leer' || newData.child('pagesRead').val() === 0)

genre..validate: newData.val() === 'Novela' || newData.val() === 'Ciencia ficción' || newData.val() === 'Historia' || newData.val() === 'Desarrollo personal'
